title: KL-JB HSR project among issues to be raised in Parliament on Thursday (Dec 9) | The Star
text:
KL-JB HSR project among issues to be raised in Parliament on Thursday (Dec 9) | The Star
KUALA LUMPUR: The issue surrounding the Kuala Lumpur-Johor Baru High Speed ​​Rail (HSR) project is expected to be the focus of the Dewan Rakyat sitting on Thursday (Dec 9).
According to the Order Paper on the Parliament website, it will be raised by Lim Guan Eng (PH-Bagan) during the Ministers’ Question Time to the Prime Minister.
